referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Market dataset representing the supply of flax insulation in Switzerland. The market share of ARBIO was estimated to 90% by Gaëlle Talandier. The remaining 10% are produced in France and charged with a 10% addition for non-declaration of information. Transport efforts for the imported share are calculated according to the procedure described in the QualiBOB report part A.; Geography: Switzerland
